# PILOTO MECANICO AURALY - 10 VARIACOES POR PUZZLE

## ORIGINAL STRUCTURE / PUZZLE

Hook mudo com anomalia visual, eleicao pessoal, selo 222 e CTA de crescimento. Este arquivo existe
somente para validar o contrato de hooks por Puzzle; nao representa uma producao publicada.

## Roteiro cena a cena

### T1 - HOOK MUDO - B-ROLL - SEM FALA
> *(sem fala)*

### T2 - ELEICAO - TALKING
> "This sign found you today because the universe is already moving one specific connection closer to your path."

### T3 - SELO - TALKING
> "Type two two two below, because writing it ties this message to your name and keeps the path open."

### T4 - FOLLOW - TALKING
> "Follow me now, so the next sign reaches you while this connection is still moving in your direction."
